There are 8 distinct body parts to cut (2 claws and 6 legs), and the weak point must be attacked last. So we count the orderings of the 8 parts that satisfy the claw condition.

The first claw cut must come at position 4 or later, because everything before it is a leg and at least three legs must already be cut. The second claw can then be at any later position.

1. Choose the positions of the two claws among positions 4 through 8: C(5,2) = 10 ways.
2. Assign the two distinct claws to those positions: 2! = 2 ways.
3. Arrange the 6 distinct legs in the remaining positions: 6! = 720 ways.

Total: 10 × 2 × 720 = 14400.

ANSWER: 14400
